reviews.text:
I recommend Allo Ronrons without hesitation! The owner is caring, warm, and very well-organized. During my cat's stay, she regularly sent me photos and updates, which was very reassuring.
It's immediately clear that she adores cats and has a real gift with them. The facilities are spotless, and all instructions regarding the care and routines of each guest are carefully noted and followed.
I also appreciate the seriousness with which she ensures the safety of all the cats in her care. She makes sure that each guest is vaccinated and dewormed, and that their FIV test is negative. A cage-free cat boarding facility where you can entrust your companion with complete confidence. I highly recommend Allo Ronrons!

Superb cat-sitting service for our little Mitaines. Very professional, very clean, and very attentive to the cats' well-being. They provided regular check-ins on the guests at the Allô Ronrons hotel. Mitaines let out a little "No" when we went to get her, as she was comfortable and in good company.

This summer, our beloved cat stayed with Bérénice, and we are beyond thrilled with the service she provided.

Bérénice possesses a way with cats and a skill we've never encountered before. Her love for animals is evident from the very first contact, as are her professionalism, knowledge, and extensive experience with cats.

We were apprehensive about leaving our cat with a sitter for the first time, in a hotel without cages. But through our email exchanges and then during our in-person meeting with Bérénice, we were quickly reassured. The place is specially designed for cats and focused on their comfort and well-being. We therefore left on our trip with complete peace of mind and confidence.

During our absence, Bérénice regularly gave us updates on Moka. It was incredibly reassuring to see him calm, happy, and in good hands.

Upon his return, our kitty was relaxed and very happy, which, for us, speaks volumes about the quality of his stay.

You can entrust your cat to Bérénice without hesitation. She is simply amazing, and we will certainly not hesitate to use her services again.

A huge thank you for everything, from us and from Moka! 😊❤️

We used Allo Ronrons for our little one's first solo vacation and we don't regret our choice at all! Berenice is very attentive to the needs of slightly stressed cat parents and to the animals themselves! We discovered along the way that we have an only cat who doesn't really enjoy the company of other cats, and Berenice helped us put a plan B in place!
Thanks to Valérie, we were able to finish our vacation peacefully with our little one back home in a more suitable environment! Allo Ronrons is an excellent way to have our cats looked after safely, and as a bonus, we regularly receive photos, videos, and updates.

A big thank you to the team!

It was the first time my cat had been around other animals, and the experience with Bérénice was simply exceptional. Her love for cats is immediately apparent. Allo Ronrons will definitely be my go-to choice for future trips. Thank you, Bérénice!

We had our cat boarded at the hotel without a carrier for five nights. The overall experience was excellent. From the very beginning of the process of opening Gordon's file, Bérénice was available to answer our many questions. We felt confident immediately. The facilities are exceptionally well-equipped for cat guests. The room for new guests was very clean and suitable. Upon arrival, our cat seemed to quickly settle in (he's usually quite timid). We then received several messages over the weekend, including photos and videos, to keep us updated on our feline friend's stay. Usually, when our cat comes home after being outside, he's a little distant for a few days. This time, it was quite the opposite. Gordon was calm, affectionate, and playful. This speaks volumes about the quality of care he received at Bérénice's. We will definitely use Âllo Ronrons again.

Excellent pet-sitting service!

We had our two cats looked after at our home, one of whom is diabetic. We met the owner of Allo Ronron, who came to our house in person to gather all the necessary information before our departure. She was incredibly kind, and we immediately sensed her love for animals and her extensive expertise.

We were fortunate to have Béatrice as our sitter, who is simply exceptional! Beyond her expertise in administering insulin injections, she sent us beautiful photos of our cats, and her reports were just perfect: so well-written, full of humor and tenderness! We also felt her genuine care and love for animals.

We were pleasantly surprised by the entire service, which far exceeded our expectations.

Super expérience!!! I used Allo Ronrons for the first time this summer 2026. the reservation was fast, flexible, reassuring. It was the first time i was using a service at home to take care of my old FIV grumpy orange cat. the result was beyond my expectations. Moutarde got used to the caretaker quite fast, she kept sending me images and videos every day, and I could just enjoy my vacations without concerns about my cat or my home. it's great to be able to go through a company that manages so well the service they offer.
Merci Allo Ronrons! Toute l'équipe a été super. Moutarde envoie un merci à Marjorie!

Fantastic experience with Allo Ronrons! I just got back from a 10-day trip and everything went perfectly. My cats were in great hands and the communication was excellent – ​​frequent and reassuring! I highly recommend them!

We boarded our cat at Allô Ronrons for three weeks this summer. It was her first time staying in another home with other cats.

Everything went very well! The space is well-equipped with several perches and a screened balcony allowing the cats to go outside safely.

Bérénice takes excellent care of her guests, and we receive regular updates during their stay. I highly recommend this cat hotel.

Bérénice was wonderful with our little Roxie. It was the first time we'd left her with someone else while we were away, and we don't regret our decision at all. The apartment is equipped to make a cat feel comfortable. The concept of the introduction room is fantastic and reassuring for a cat's adjustment. It's clear that Bérénice understands cats' needs and loves taking care of them. Thank you, Bérénice!

My partner and I greatly appreciated Bérénice's reliability and professionalism. My almost 19-year-old cat stayed at Allo Ronrons for three weeks, and clearly, he had a wonderful time. We received regular updates and photos of Minou, which was very reassuring. You can entrust your beloved pet to Bérénice without any hesitation.

I entrusted my cat, Rose, to this small, cage-free cat hotel run by Bérénice, and the experience was simply exceptional. Unlike larger establishments, everything here is on a human scale: Bérénice cares for a small group of cats, including her own, creating a calm, warm, and almost familial atmosphere.

From the very beginning, you can feel a genuine passion and deep respect for animals. Bérénice takes the time to get to know each cat, to understand their personality and needs. Rose, who is usually rather reserved, felt at ease very quickly thanks to her gentle and caring approach.
I particularly appreciated the fact that the cats live together in a safe and stimulating environment, with plenty of individual attention. It's far from simple cat-sitting: it's a true wellness experience for them. Receiving updates and seeing Rose relaxed and at ease reassured me enormously during our absence.
Upon our return, Rose was serene, in excellent health, and clearly very well cared for. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking for personalized, caring, and high-quality childcare. A huge thank you to Bérénice — Rose will definitely be back!

Allô Ronrons is a true little paradise for cats. Bérénice is dedicated to animal welfare. She treats her guests with great care and demonstrates high professionalism. My little Nacho spent 10 days in a comforting and stimulating environment. I recommend it 100%!

If you're one of those cat parents who want to travel with peace of mind, knowing your furry friend is in a warm home, surrounded by love and care, look no further, Allo Ronrons is the perfect place. Nothing is left to chance; Bérénice knows cats inside and out and adapts to their individual personalities. We feel so lucky to have found the best cat sitter for our Comète :)

We loved our experience with Allo Ronrons! Bérénice is very professional and took excellent care of our furry friends while we were away. The regular updates let us know that our cats were delighted, and so were we!
Thank you again, we highly recommend Bérénice for your cats! You can trust her completely!

I left my cat Stanley at Allo Ronron while I was in London. They kept me regularly updated with photos and videos, which was very thoughtful of them. My cat loved it, became friends with their cat, and even seemed a little sad to leave when I came to pick him up. I highly recommend them.

Hello,
An efficient and competent organization that takes great care of our beloved pets. Satisfaction guaranteed.
Thank you, Olivier, for coming to give our beautiful Scarlette some love! She enjoyed your cuddles.

Josée

I left my 13-year-old cat in Bérénice's care this summer and I'm very happy with the kindness she showed him, as well as the regular updates she provided. I highly recommend her services, thank you so much!
Bérénice takes excellent care of the cats, she provides regular updates, the place is very clean and very cat-friendly. They have a wonderful stay. I highly recommend it!

We had a fantastic experience with Allo Ronrons. Our cat stayed in the integration room for a short stay, and was clearly well looked after and loved while there. We appreciated the triage process to ensure that the staff could provide as best as possible a smooth stay for our minou. Communication / updates with the staff were easy, quick, honest and reassuring while he was in their care.
We 100% will use their services again in the future and recommend their high quality of care to other families with cats

Like many others who have commented here, we were anxious about leaving our cat for two weeks.

Reading the numerous positive reviews reassured us, and we decided to trust Allo Ronrons.

No regrets whatsoever!

Bérénice is extremely professional and clearly has the skills to provide top-notch service. Furthermore, it's obvious that she adores cats and that they all receive the amount of affection and love they need.

We are truly delighted with the experience and will bring our cat back without hesitation! :)

We left with complete peace of mind, knowing our Jujube was in very good hands! We received numerous videos and photos to reassure us. It was the first time we'd left our cat with anyone, and we're delighted with the service we received. A huge thank you for the excellent care!
A true cat daycare. We left our Princess there with complete confidence. Berenice really knows her stuff. We received regular videos and updates. It was reassuring.

We were worried about leaving our cat during our vacation, but after the initial visit with Bérénice, we were already reassured to entrust her with our cat. She took the time to understand our cat's environment. We loved receiving updates and photos during our stay; we could see from the pictures that our cat was doing well and had settled in nicely with her cat sitter, Marguerite. We were able to enjoy our vacation with complete peace of mind. We found our cat in perfect health. We will definitely use Allo Ronrons again without a second thought :).

I was very anxious about leaving my cats alone for the first time, but everything went very well. My cats are very timid with strangers, and one of them needs an inhaler to treat his asthma. Their sitter, Marie-Ève, amazed me. Not only was she able to give him his medication, but she also petted them; they came to her and seemed very comfortable in the videos. I also really enjoyed the daily updates with photos and videos. The initial visit with Bérénice, the owner, had already reassured me a lot. She is very professional and gave us excellent advice on the best service for our cats: home visits rather than a cat hotel for our sensitive little ones. Thank you!

A huge thank you to Bérénice for the wonderful welcome my cat received.

For the first time ever, I was able to have a truly relaxing vacation; my cat was in excellent hands: cuddled, looked after, and well-fed. "Allô Ronron" will now be his 5-star hotel without a doubt!

This is the first time we've left our cat with someone, and it's far from the last! Allo Ronron was the best cat hotel I could have dreamed of for our little Nala. Bérénice took excellent care of her from beginning to end and sent us photos and videos throughout her stay. Nala was very well looked after and will be with all her friends next time! Thank you again for this wonderful stay.

Travel with complete peace of mind!
As parents of two senior cats, one of whom is diabetic, going away for even just one night is quite complicated. So when I found the in-home pet-sitting service from Allô Ronrons, I thought, why not give it a try? While I was initially a little taken aback by the fact that communication was only via email (I like to chat with people to get a feel for them), I was quickly reassured by Bénérice's team, and her visit to our home sealed the deal, confirming their professionalism, attention to detail, and above all, their love for furry friends. We left with complete confidence for our first little vacation in two years. What a relief! :) And what did the cats think? Five-star service! They didn't even seem to miss us a little, haha! And ever since, they go to the door as soon as someone arrives, probably thinking it's their favorite babysitter coming to say hello ;)
We have been super happy with our experience with Allo RonRons. Very professional, efficient, and more importantly, great with our cats! Will definitely call them next time!
My two cats didn't seem to have noticed my absence when I returned; they were so well pampered by the Allo Ronrons team! Warm service and happy cats, I highly recommend them!

I had a wonderful experience with Bérénice. Attentiveness, gentleness, and professionalism are paramount in her business. My cat received the utmost care during his stay. I highly recommend Allo Ronrons!!
Thank you again 🫶 …

Incredible experience with Allô Ronrons! 😸 I felt confident from the start and had absolutely no worries about leaving my beautiful Louise in such good hands. I received frequent updates that reassured me throughout the 10-day stay. I wouldn't hesitate for a second to use Allô Ronrons again for pet sitting! A huge thank you to you, Bérénice! 😻

Thanks to Bérénice and her company Allo Ronrons, I had a wonderful, worry-free vacation! It was the first time I'd left my cat in the capable hands of someone outside the home, and the photos and videos quickly reassured me, as did the initial visit. When I returned, it was as if I hadn't even left; my cat was just as confident as usual. Bérénice has a real understanding of cat behavior and runs her business with great professionalism (contracts, employees, etc.). Thank you so much, Bérénice, for this invaluable service!

I enjoyed the cat-sitting service so much that I've already booked for my next vacation. Bérénice was very welcoming to my cat from the start. He had a wonderful stay. I received regular updates, as well as photos and videos. I highly recommend her.
The sitter is very sensitive and has an excellent understanding of cats' needs and reflexes. It was our first experience, and B kept us regularly updated on our cat's progress. Highly recommended!

Our cat Charlot was pampered by Bérénice. She takes excellent care of cats and understands their behavior very well. We received daily updates with photos and videos. I wholeheartedly recommend Bérénice's services for your cat. Thank you.

That's so sweet, thank you Guévin! Everyone loved having Koupik here, both the humans and the other kitties. I hope to see him again soon. 🐈💕
 …

I highly recommend Allo Ronrons! I received incredibly professional and efficient service. Bérénice took such loving and attentive care of my cat! She's very knowledgeable, puts both my cat and me at ease, and adapts to everyone's needs. My cat was very comfortable from the moment we arrived at the hotel! I received regular updates with photos and videos throughout the stay. A huge thank you for the excellent care! I will definitely be contacting them again on my next trip!

Bérénice took such good care of my cat Stitch with such attention and professionalism! During his stay, she sent me adorable photos, which was so reassuring. When I picked him up, Stitch was relaxed and in great shape. Thank you again for this excellent service, I recommend her 100%! 🐾 …

Bérénice and Noémie took excellent care of Paco while we were away. We received updates, lots of photos and videos. They followed all our requests to the letter!
It was a real pleasure to have such professional and passionate people looking after our cat while we were gone!

I highly recommend this cattery if you want your kitty treated like royalty! We were a little apprehensive about leaving our Fabio for the first time for two weeks, but Bérénice is very professional and gives her little guests lots of love. …

I used Allo Ronrons' home visit service for my kitten Mila and I couldn't have asked for a better experience! From the very first communication during the registration process, I felt confident. The registration form was very detailed and …

I relied on the positive reviews on Google for this company. And I wasn't wrong! I'm one of the very happy cat moms who left my little Maya in the capable hands of Leonie, her favorite sitter ❤️. She knew how to listen to my little Maya, …

Kibo had a wonderful three-week stay at this cattery, which was very attentive to our cats. We also use the services of Allo Ronron, who are always available for home visits! A professional and caring cattery! I highly recommend it!

I couldn't have imagined a better stay at Allo Ronrons! Haku had the best cattery of his life and was even sad to go home! Bérénice is patient, gentle, and attentive to each cat's needs. She introduces each cat at their own pace and …
